subject: [hw] DONE X01 rev 1: 434/434; raw-T02 diff check, README/STATUS sync (commit e61975a)
body:
DONE X01 rev 1. Host-only; no phone, no publish, no daemon edit. Since the first DONE:

- tests/t_check.py: added a raw T02 recorder file vs X01 phone-format file comparison through diff_logs.py (exit 0, identical writes=1); Python checks 33 -> 34.
- README: documented that a raw log SCRIPT set / SCRIPT irq line is treated as an effect (read overrides + explicit irq rules), not copied and duplicated.
- run_tests.sh: also removes the iOS object at cleanup.
- STATUS/README final count synced.

    bash gpu/hwcodec/hwlog/run_tests.sh
    N2TEST X01 PASS 434/434

Last run: 33 s on a loaded host. Counts: asan 36+36+36+39+14, o2 36+36+36+39+14, tsan 36+14, cap0 9+9, python 34, shell diffs + iOS compile; the literal expected log is byte-identical and the log2script replay reproduces the full 29-line log.

Commits: 0bbb7ae (package), e61975a (rev 1). Files: hwlog/** + dsh-state/workers/X01/STATUS.md. The not-done list from the first DONE is unchanged (no phone run; hw-ip hook + _fileno pending; no real vendor log yet; documented POLL/IRQ/DMA-window limits). Staying available for review findings.
